No captions, labels or extra characters. Keep composition and background consistent. Do not copy phrase-specific words or incidental camera angles. Catalog ID: anticipation-curious-subtle-silent. Silent anticipation: columns upright attentive, leaning forward slightly, leaning forward with brows raised and shoulders lifted. Closed lips throughout, curious excited eyes. Talking columns: closed lips, partly open speech mouth, open speech mouth. Silent columns follow the explicit gesture progression with closed lips. Target emotion must stay visibly distinct across all six frames. No adult face, no text, no labels.
IMPORTANT: SILENT animation: every mouth fully CLOSED. Follow explicit gesture progression across columns, NOT the speech mouth variants in reference 2.
